{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = (loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)

# Remove QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue on cleaned subset
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print results
print(f'Number of loyal completed orders (before QA filter): {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'Number of loyal completed orders (after QA filter): {len(loyal_completed_clean)}')
print(f'Mean revenue (before QA filter): {loyal_completed[~qa_mask].mean():.2f}')
print(f'Mean revenue (after QA filter): {mean_revenue_clean:.2f}')"}
